name: Genshin Impact mobile HUD (default layout)
notes: Calibrated on a 2400x1080 Android emulator (default touch layout, zh-CN client). x/y are control centres on the reference screen; the anchor edge keeps its distance when the aspect ratio differs. w/h are tap-area sizes. Probes are reference-space pixels with expected RGB; the first screen whose probes all match is reported. Recalibrate with `pnpm agent layout --layout layouts/genshin-impact.json --out artifacts/layout.png`. Interaction prompt lists (1–5 entries, centred at y 538 with a 90 px pitch) were measured with 1 and 3 entries and extrapolated for 2, 4 and 5; reply options were measured with two options only. Button `text` and screen `texts` boxes are OCR regions: prompt labels span x 1480–1760, reply options x 1535–1800, and the dialogue speaker and two subtitle lines sit above the bottom edge.

enemy.label: Enemy HP bars 敌人血条

routines.label: Go to quest marker 前往任务标记
routines.description: Code turns the camera toward the tracked quest's yellow marker on the minimap and runs toward it for up to about 25 seconds (longer when screenshots are slow), re-aiming as it goes. It stops when the marker reaches the character (arrived), when someone to talk to appears, when the screen leaves the open world, or when the character is stuck. The quest distance text shows the remaining distance; use it again while the distance keeps shrinking. If the quest is more than 150m away, use teleport first instead of walking; walking that far can lead into water or cliffs. When the quest marks an area (a yellow ring on the minimap, HUD 已到达任务区域), it walks to the area's centre and reports arrived there; the quest goal is then somewhere around that spot.

routines.label: Explore 随机游走
routines.description: Code walks the character a short distance roughly straight ahead (where the camera faces, within 30° either side): up to 5 short hops of about one step each, checking the screen standing still after every hop, and stops as soon as a new interaction prompt appears, a new enemy HP bar appears (enemy), the screen leaves the open world, or the character stays stuck. Use it to look for something to pick up, talk to or interact with; if nothing appears, use it again to keep exploring further.

routines.label: Continue dialogue 自动推进对话
routines.description: Code taps through the conversation until reply options appear (then you choose one), the open world returns (the conversation ended), or it stops changing. Up to 60 seconds.

routines.label: Fight 战斗
routines.description: Code fights nearby enemies: each active character uses elemental skill, a few normal attacks, then tries the burst, then the next teammate who is still standing is switched in (downed teammates are skipped; a revive dialog is closed with 取消 without using items). It always fights one round first (attacks turn towards the nearest enemy), then watches for red enemy HP bars: if none appeared it stops (no_enemy), and once they have been gone for 2 checks in a row it stops (clear). It does not walk towards enemies, so get close first; otherwise it runs up to 45 seconds.

routines.label: Approach enemy 接近敌人
routines.description: Code looks for the nearest enemy: an HP bar, or a distant enemy's level label (Lv.) when it is too far away for a bar. If none is in view it first turns towards a red off-screen enemy arrow and walks a step towards it, and otherwise turns the camera around in place (a full circle, ending facing the same way as before). It then walks towards the enemy, turning the camera to keep it centred, and stops once the enemy is within fighting range (near), when no enemy is found all around (no_enemy), when it loses sight of the enemy (lost), or when the character is stuck. Use it whenever an enemy is visible or indicated, even far away, and to search for enemies before exploring further; use Fight 战斗 after it reports the enemy is near.

routines.label: Teleport near quest 传送到任务附近
routines.description: Code opens the world map, centres it on the tracked quest, picks the unlocked teleport waypoint or Statue of The Seven nearest to the quest, confirms its teleport panel by OCR, taps 传送 once and waits for the open world to load. Use it when the tracked quest distance is more than 150m instead of walking; if code finds the quest close to you on the map it closes the map without teleporting, and you should walk there with navigate. While swimming it teleports even to a close quest, because swimming toward it can end at a cliff. On failure the world map may stay open; press BACK to close it.

routines.label: Heal at Statue 七天神像回血
routines.description: Code opens the world map and teleports to a visible unlocked Statue of The Seven so its automatic blessing can restore a low-health party. Use it when the active character has at most 25% health. If no statue is visible at the current map zoom, it leaves the map open and continuous play falls back to another activity.

routines.label: Track quest 追踪任务
routines.description: Code makes sure a quest is tracked. If the HUD already shows a quest distance it does nothing. Otherwise it opens the quest log 任务, and if the selected quest (usually the newest) is not tracked it taps 追踪目标 once, returns to the open world and checks that the HUD shows the quest. Use it when no tracked quest objective is shown on the HUD.
